preconditions.expression:
N := 0
node := head
while node is not None:
    N += 1
    node = node.next
1 <= N <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The linked list has a size N between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, where N is the number of nodes in the list starting from head.
Every node in the linked list has an integer value (node.val).

postconditions.expression: return_value == all(head.val == node.val for head, node in zip(reversed_linked_list(head), linked_list(head)))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if the linked list reads the same forwards and backwards (i.e., it is a palindrome). The comparison is done by traversing the list from head to end (forward) and from end to head (backward) simultaneously, checking if corresponding node values match.
